software-engineer.title: Software Development Engineer - Campus / Early Career
software-engineer.overviewTemplate: Design, implement, and maintain scalable software services and applications at {{companyName}}.
keyResponsibilities: Write modular, testable, and efficient code adhering to engineering best practices.
Collaborate with senior engineers to design and build core microservices and UI components.
Participate in code reviews, automated unit testing, and continuous integration pipelines.
Diagnose, debug, and resolve issues across development, staging, and production environments.

backend-engineer.title: Backend Software Engineer
backend-engineer.overviewTemplate: Build resilient backend APIs, event pipelines, and high-throughput data services at {{companyName}}.
keyResponsibilities: Develop robust RESTful and gRPC APIs powering critical business workflows.
Optimize database queries, indexing strategies, and caching layers for low latency.
Implement distributed messaging queues and asynchronous background workers.
Ensure compliance with system security, zero-egress data standards, and monitoring telemetry.

frontend-engineer.title: Frontend Software Engineer
frontend-engineer.overviewTemplate: Engineer performant, accessible, and responsive user interfaces at {{companyName}}.
keyResponsibilities: Develop accessible and responsive web applications using modern UI component frameworks.
Translate wireframes and system requirements into performant, polished user experiences.
Optimize client-side bundle performance, network caching, and rendering metrics.
Implement client-side unit and end-to-end accessibility test suites.
requiredSkills: CSS3, Responsive Layouts, and Web Standards

data-engineer.title: Data Platform Engineer
data-engineer.overviewTemplate: Design, build, and operate large-scale data ingestion and transformation pipelines at {{companyName}}.
keyResponsibilities: Build batch and stream processing pipelines for diverse data sources.
Maintain data warehousing models, schema evolutions, and data quality checks.
Optimize distributed computation jobs for throughput, cost, and reliability.
Collaborate with analytics teams to structure clean semantic data layers.

qa-automation.title: Quality Assurance & Test Automation Engineer
qa-automation.overviewTemplate: Ensure comprehensive software reliability and release quality through automated testing at {{companyName}}.
keyResponsibilities: Develop and maintain automated integration, API, and regression test suites.
Identify defect patterns, edge cases, and performance regressions early in CI/CD cycles.
Collaborate with developers to establish rigorous automated test coverage gates.
Conduct exploratory testing on mission-critical platform releases.
